tldr.text: This lesson is about frameworks, standards and regulations, and how to tell them apart. Start with where the authority comes from. Laws must be met, contracts were agreed to, and frameworks are chosen, often because customers ask for them.

ISO 27001 is a certifiable management system. Clauses four to ten all apply, while the Annex A controls are chosen and justified in a Statement of Applicability. An accredited certification body issues a certificate for a defined scope.
tldr.say: I S O twenty-seven thousand one is a certifiable management system. Clauses four to ten all apply, while the Annex A controls are chosen and justified in a Statement of Applicability. An accredited certification body issues a certificate for a defined scope.

tldr.text: SOC 2 is an attestation, not a certificate. A CPA firm examines your controls against the Trust Services Criteria and issues a report with its opinion. Security is always in scope, and the other four categories are optional.
tldr.say: Sock two is an attestation, not a certificate. A C P A firm examines your controls against the Trust Services Criteria and issues a report with its opinion. Security is always in scope, and the other four categories are optional.

tldr.text: The voluntary frameworks issue nothing, but they give your program structure. NIST CSF 2.0 describes outcomes in six functions. NIST SP 800-53 is a detailed control catalog, and CIS Controls version eight sets a prioritized order to start from.
tldr.say: The voluntary frameworks issue nothing, but they give your program structure. Nist C S F two point oh describes outcomes in six functions. Nist special publication eight hundred fifty-three is a detailed control catalog, and C I S Controls version eight sets a prioritized order to start from.

tldr.text: Choosing is less about which framework is best and more about who is asking. List what the law requires first, then what customers require, then what the business needs. Then sequence the audits so one control set serves them all.

A crosswalk maps each of your controls to every requirement it answers, which gives you a common control set. Mark each mapping as equivalent, partial, broader or related, and note the edition, so a partial match stays visible before an auditor finds it.

Next, try the exercises to sort obligations by type, order the steps for choosing frameworks and pick the stronger answer to a customer. Then build your own one-page crosswalk, or go straight to the knowledge check.

activities.title: Where does its authority come from?
activities.prompt: Sort each obligation for a software company serving clinics in the US and Europe by what makes it binding and what, if anything, gets issued.

items.text: The HIPAA Security Rule, for a vendor handling health data for US clinics
items.why: It is a US regulation that applies directly to a business associate, whatever the company prefers.

items.text: The GDPR, for processing patient data for European clinics
items.why: It is an EU regulation enforced by supervisory authorities.

items.text: PCI DSS, reaching the company through the card brands and its bank
items.why: PCI DSS is binding because the merchant agreed to it, and the card brands enforce it, not a government.

items.text: A customer contract term setting a deadline for breach notice
items.why: It binds the company because it signed the contract, and the customer enforces it.

items.text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, audited by an accredited certification body
items.why: It is a certifiable standard: a certificate is issued for a defined scope.

items.text: SOC 2, with the security category in scope
items.why: It is an attestation framework: a CPA firm issues a report with its opinion, not a certificate.

items.text: NIST CSF 2.0, used to report the program to the board in six functions
items.why: The CSF issues nothing; organizations build their own profiles with it.
It is a prioritized control set used as a starting baseline, with nothing issued.

items.text: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, at a company that runs no US federal systems
items.why: It is mandatory only for US federal systems; elsewhere it is a reference catalog.

activities.title: Choose and sequence the frameworks
activities.prompt: Put the steps a GRC lead takes to choose frameworks and plan the audits in order.
steps: List what the law requires, since those are not choices
Read contracts, lost deals and questionnaires for what customers require
Pick a voluntary framework to structure and report on the program
Build one control set against the chosen frameworks and the legal obligations
Take the examination that unblocks the most revenue first
Pursue the next certification on the same controls and evidence
activities.why: Legal obligations come first because they are not optional, and customers decide which audits matter. Building one control set before any audit lets the second audit reuse the first one's controls and evidence.

activities.title: Answer like a GRC lead
activities.prompt: Each pair is two ways to handle the same question about frameworks or mappings. Pick the stronger one.

pairs.a: Asked for a SOC 2 certificate, send the certificate and its renewal date
pairs.b: Asked for a SOC 2 certificate, explain it is an attestation and offer the CPA firm's report
pairs.why: SOC 2 issues a report with an opinion, usually shared under a nondisclosure agreement, never a certificate.

pairs.a: Asked about HIPAA, use the crosswalk to show which ISO controls answer it and where the gaps are
pairs.b: Asked about HIPAA, explain that the ISO/IEC 27001 certificate already covers it
pairs.why: Frameworks overlap with laws but do not replace them, so the crosswalk is the honest answer.

pairs.a: Record that MFA covers SOC 2 CC6.1
pairs.b: Record MFA as a partial match for CC6.1 and name the controls for granting, removing and reviewing access
pairs.why: Marking the mapping partial, with the other controls named, keeps the gap visible before an auditor finds it.

pairs.a: Record the edition, owner and last review date on each mapping
pairs.b: Map once, since requirement numbers stay the same between editions
pairs.why: Editions renumber and regroup requirements, so dated mappings turn an update into a planned review.
